notes.characters: Bandit has an appealing face and strong striped silhouette, and the bruiser, banded hatchling and sleeper provide useful cast variety (mobile/r06-nursery.png, desktop/r08-barn.png, mobile/r13-results.png). Repeated side-on gators and the rather compressed swimmer bodies keep the cast below top-tier character polish (desktop/r04-pond.png, mobile/r05-whippers.png).
notes.environment: The title painting offers rich vegetation, masonry and a convincing boardwalk, but play reduces that richness to repetitive, abruptly joined texture strips with scattered props (desktop/r01-title.png, desktop/r03-l1-start.png). Nursery fencing and barn hay communicate zones, though their repetition and the plain geometric barn framing weaken the painted cohesion (desktop/r06-nursery.png, desktop/r08-barn.png).
notes.depth: Modeled sprites, waterline scallops and ground shadows establish some volume, but long hard oval shadows and flat horizontal banks feel like separate compositing layers (mobile/r11-hop.png, desktop/r07-feeding.png). Night adds atmosphere without sufficiently separating dark bodies from dark water, while barn beams visibly occlude the hero (mobile/r09-night.png, mobile/r08-barn.png).
notes.readability: Water versus land and yellow warning badges are easy to distinguish, but the badge sits a row above its red mouth ellipse and does not outline a clear dangerous tile (mobile/r03-l1-start.png, mobile/r11-hop.png). Tiny lane floats, busy water texture and low night contrast make exact riding and landing regions less obvious than the shippable anchor requires (mobile/r04-pond.png, mobile/r12-endless.png).
notes.ui: Cream panels, teal headings and yellow primary actions form a consistent hierarchy with generous portrait buttons (mobile/r01-title.png, mobile/r13-results.png). The map is a dense stack of nearly identical cards and help is a long text wall, with outlined headings visibly stair-stepped at full size (mobile/r02-map.png, mobile/r14-help.png).
notes.juice: The airborne pose and carried snacks communicate a hop, but feedback consists mainly of straight white strokes, circles and a waist-level ring rather than a convincing contact burst (desktop/r11-hop.png, mobile/r11b-land.png). Sparkle rays and wakes provide activity, yet the geometric FX look simpler than the painted assets; stills do not establish animation timing or smoothness (desktop/r03-l1-start.png, mobile/r07-feeding.png).
notes.mobile: The opaque HUD and footer keep controls legible, and results fit comfortably in portrait (mobile/r03-l1-start.png, mobile/r13-results.png). The narrow crop loses most of the boss body and farm margin props, a beam crosses Bandit's face, and an endless warning is partly hidden beneath the header (mobile/r10-boss.png, mobile/r08-barn.png, mobile/r12-endless.png).
notes.authenticity: Gators, nursery fencing, eggs and feeding equipment convey an animal farm, while the title explicitly names Hot Springs and disclaims affiliation (desktop/r06-nursery.png, desktop/r07-feeding.png, mobile/r01-title.png). In play, repetitive pools and generic vegetation provide little distinctive Hot Springs identity, especially when portrait crops away the margin props (desktop/r04-pond.png, mobile/r06-nursery.png).
notes.ip_gate: PASS on the supplied visual evidence: no recognizable commercial-game mascot, bird/pig/slingshot motif, real logo or real signage was observed; the raccoon and gator cast and illustrated gator-and-pecan signs read as original (desktop/r03-l1-start.png, desktop/r10-boss.png, mobile/r13-results.png). The real venue is named in the title disclaimer, with an explicit non-affiliation statement rather than an endorsement (mobile/r01-title.png).

gaps.issue: An opaque horizontal barn beam runs directly across Bandit's face/body and across the playable field.
gaps.fix: Keep roof beams in side margins, or fade their intersecting segments around the hero and occupied hazard tiles using a Canvas2D mask; retain suspension cues for lamps.

gaps.issue: Dark olive gators and their tails merge into navy water; eyes and bright snacks dominate before the actual riding surfaces do.
gaps.fix: Lift local luminance on all playable gator backs, add a restrained cool silhouette rim, and reduce water texture contrast under the night overlay.

gaps.issue: Warnings float far above mouth rings, can appear to refer to the adjacent row, and the top endless badge is cut off by the header.
gaps.fix: Anchor a compact badge beside each mouth and draw a translucent tile-sized danger footprint on its actual row; clamp the whole indicator group inside the board viewport.

gaps.issue: Identical bright grass and caustic water repeat across ruler-straight strips, with little of the title painting's organic edge detail.
gaps.fix: Commission several low-contrast tileable ground variants plus irregular bank edge strips; blend them with seeded Canvas2D placement while keeping lane centers clean.

gaps.issue: Long sharp oval land shadows extend well beyond gator feet and look detached from the soft painted lighting.
gaps.fix: Use a tight dark contact shadow beneath each belly and a broader faint blurred shadow with consistent light direction; shorten projections under overhead lighting.

gaps.issue: Landing is represented by a white ring around the lower torso and disconnected white dots over sand, with little visible contact response from the gator.
gaps.fix: Anchor the impact ellipse at the feet on the gator's back, emit short tapered droplets at the waterline, and add a brief gator dip and hero squash pose.

gaps.issue: Portrait shows only the boss's head fragment and loses the signposts and incubator context visible on desktop.
gaps.fix: Use a portrait-specific world scale or brief boss camera framing that reveals its silhouette, and reserve narrow safe margins for a few farm-identifying props.

gaps.issue: Help relies on dense prose to explain visually similar gator rules, while the map offers repeated text cards with no zone illustrations.
gaps.fix: Draw small painted gator diagrams with highlighted safe backs and dangerous mouths beside short rules; add a compact zone vignette to each map group.

gaps.issue: Many lanes repeat the same two swimmer poses, and striped whippers largely share the ordinary paddler silhouette.
gaps.fix: Commission a curled, raised tail and a distinct head profile for whippers plus a few consistent paddler pose variants, preserving a stable rideable back contour.

gaps.issue: Hot Springs identity is carried mostly by title text and generic spring imagery; gameplay reads as interchangeable cartoon pools.
gaps.fix: Commission original, non-branded stone spring channels, an illustrated local-hills backdrop and visitor enclosure details; place a small selection inside portrait-visible safe rows.

gaps.issue: Flashlight wedges have visibly stepped straight edges and luminous pools look pasted over surfaces; barn wall windows are flat rectangles beside detailed sprites.
gaps.fix: Render light cones to an offscreen canvas with continuous alpha falloff and surface masks, and replace barn windows/posts with shaded painted pieces sharing the sprite palette.
